meta.parties: Tikiri Banda v. Appuhamy Et Al

rules.statement: A diga married husband has a life interest in the acquired property of his deceased wife if there are children.
rules.supporting_quote: "I think that some operation should be given to the paragraph in Sawers cited before us. That it does not apply to a binna marriage or to paraveni property sufficiently appears from other passages in Sawers and from the authorities referred to by Mr. Justice Pereira. The only other case to which it can be applied is to the acquired property of a woman in diga, and I think the decision in Saduwa v. Siri 2 [8 Bal. 18.] correctly holds that the husband has a life interest in the property acquired by the wife during such a marriage."
